## Alarm Thresholds and Response Matrix - Production Line A

Document: SOP-002 | Rev: 1.8 | Date: 2025-10-20 | Author: Ing. L. Greco - Automation & Control

Threshold hierarchy: CRIT_LO < WARN_LO < NOMINAL < WARN_HI < CRIT_HI.

## ST01_FILLING Thresholds

| Sensor   | Unit   |   CRIT_LO |       | WARN_LONominal   |   WARN_HI |   CRIT_HI | CRITICAL Response              |
|----------|--------|-----------|-------|------------------|-----------|-----------|--------------------------------|
| TMP      | °C     |        15 |  18   | 22.0 ± 0.4       |      26   |      30   | Inspect and notify maintenance |
| PRS      | bar    |         3 |   3.3 | 3.8 ± 0.05       |       4.2 |       4.8 | Inspect and notify maintenance |
| FLW      | L/min  |       105 | 112   | 120.0 ± 1.5      |     128   |     135   | Inspect and notify maintenance |

## Anomaly Type Definitions for KG Mapping

| Type         | Definition                                      | Detection Criterion                                  | Ontology Class                                       |
|--------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| SPIKE        | Transient deviation >3 s , <5 minSingle         | reading >CRIT                                        | AnomalyEvent::Spike                                  |
| DRIFT        | Monotonic deviation >15 min                     | Slope >0.1 s /min for 5+ readingsAnomalyEvent::Drift | Slope >0.1 s /min for 5+ readingsAnomalyEvent::Drift |
| STUCK        | Unchanged >10 consecutive                       | readings std(last 10)<0.001×nominal                  | AnomalyEvent::StuckSensor                            |
| OUT_OF_RANGE | Sustained WARN violation >10 min >WARN for 20+  | readings                                             | AnomalyEvent::OutOfRange                             |
| CORRELATED   | Causally linked to another station Onset within | 90 min of cause                                      | AnomalyEvent::Correlated                             |
